policies.title: Kickstart economic growth
policies.statement: Reform the planning system and back major infrastructure projects to deliver the highest sustained growth in the G7.

policies.title: Clean energy superpower
policies.statement: Set up a publicly owned company, GB Energy, and decarbonise the electricity grid by 2030 to cut bills and boost energy security.

policies.title: Take back our streets
policies.statement: Deliver a Neighbourhood Policing Guarantee, putting thousands more officers and PCSOs on the beat to tackle antisocial behaviour.

policies.title: An NHS fit for the future
policies.statement: Cut NHS waiting lists and shift care from hospitals into local communities, backed by more appointments and digital services.

policies.title: Break down barriers to opportunity
policies.statement: Expand access to childcare and breakfast clubs and raise school standards so background does not determine a child's future.

policies.title: Secure our borders
policies.statement: Establish a Border Security Command with counter-terrorism-style powers to dismantle the criminal gangs behind small boat crossings.
